original_ai_output.title_zh: 乍得前总理马斯拉离境赴法国就医
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 乍得前总理苏塞斯·马斯拉在获总统赦免出狱两个月后离境就医。据报道他先前往喀麦隆，随后前往家人居住的科特迪瓦，再前往法国。他离境前参加了悼念2022年10月示威镇压遇难者的活动。

key_facts.fact: 乍得前总理苏塞斯·马斯拉离境就医
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Chad: Former PM Succès Masra leaves country for medical treatment

key_facts.fact: 马斯拉在获总统赦免出狱两个月后离境
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: His departure to France for medical treatment comes two months after his release from prison following a presidential pardon.

key_facts.fact: 据报道他先前往喀麦隆，再前往科特迪瓦，随后前往法国
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He reportedly headed to Cameroon on Tuesday, before travelling to Ivory Coast where his family lives, and then on to France.

key_facts.fact: 他离境前参加了悼念2022年10月示威镇压遇难者的活动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Masra departed after taking part in a tribute to victims of the October 2022 crackdown on demonstrations demanding a return to constitutional order.

uncertainties: 行程细节（喀麦隆、科特迪瓦、法国）为据报道，尚未获独立确认
